title: The Kindynos interface
lead: The colours, the type and the components that the questionnaire and the report share. Change the language and the theme from the header.

colors.title: Colours
colors.intro: Each colour has a value for the light theme and one for the dark theme. Navy, cream, gold and blue come from the owl of the logo.

type.title: Type
type.intro: Fraunces for the titles, softened as in the wordmark, and Inter for the text.
type.display: Know the risks of your AI system, and where they come from.
type.heading: Risks by domain
type.lead: Answer 24 questions about your system: Kindynos finds its risks, says who or what causes each one, and gives you a report to keep.
type.body: Each risk has a severity, an explanation and a mitigation, and its causes along the MIT Causal Taxonomy: entity, intent and timing.
type.code: The report is also saved on this computer, in {path}.

badges.title: Badges and meters
badges.intro: Colour is never alone: every badge has its text, every meter its value.

form.title: Fields and choices
form.name_hint: It becomes the title of the report, and stays on this computer.
form.question: Is there a possibility that the system has differences in performance or accuracy across user groups?
form.question_hint: E.g. by language, age, origin, education level.
form.option_yes: Yes, there could be differences between groups
form.option_no: No, it works the same for everyone
form.followup: Specify for which groups or under what conditions these differences occur.
form.data_legend: Which data does the system learn from?

accordion.title: Accordion
accordion.data_answer: Your answers go to Gemini, Google's model, which writes the risks and the summary. A model on your computer labels their causes, and the expert rules run here too.
accordion.time_question: How long does the analysis take?
accordion.time_answer: Usually from one to three minutes.
accordion.answers_answer: Yes. Until you start the analysis they stay in this browser, and you can go back to any question.

icons.title: Icons
icons.intro: From Lucide, drawn in the colour of the text around them.
